_comment: Import in the panel under Nests → Import egg. Point the Docker image at the image you built from this repo.
name: Magic Rust Template
author: magic-services-co
description: Rust server website (Next.js + Laravel) in one container. The panel port is the public site. MariaDB or MySQL is entered in the setup wizard at /setup. HTTPS uses a Cloudflare origin certificate uploaded to /home/container/ssl/cert.pem and key.pem. Without those files the port stays HTTP.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /mnt/server/ssl
printf '%s\n' 'Upload the Cloudflare Origin Certificate PEM to cert.pem and the private key to key.pem in this folder.' 'Cloudflare SSL/TLS mode: Full (strict).' 'Allocate a Cloudflare HTTPS port: 443, 2053, 2083, 2087, 2096, or 8443.' > /mnt/server/ssl/README.txt
exit 0

variables.name: Site URL
variables.description: Public URL players open, including https://. Example: https://site.example.com

variables.name: Origin certificate path
variables.description: Cloudflare origin certificate PEM. Upload the file, then leave this path. Empty files keep the port on HTTP.

variables.name: Origin private key path
variables.description: Private key that matches the Cloudflare origin certificate.

variables.name: App key
variables.description: Leave empty. A value that is not a 32-byte Laravel key (base64:...) is ignored and one is generated on first start.

variables.name: Auth secret
variables.description: Optional NEXTAUTH_SECRET. Leave empty to generate one on first start.
